groups.description: Conventional penetrating keratoplasty (Hessburg-Barron trephination), primary grafts for Fuchs endothelial dystrophy, Rotterdam Eye Hospital 2002-2013. Same-session cataract surgery is not mentioned (combined null).

notes: Single-centre retrospective study of data collected prospectively at fixed visits in the Dutch Organ Transplant Register; all primary grafts for Fuchs endothelial dystrophy at the Rotterdam Eye Hospital between January 2002 and January 2013 (721 eyes); no minimum follow-up criterion; per-visit n decreases (ordinary attrition).
Per-eye data exist only in the supplementary spreadsheet (S1 File), which is not acquired (addendum 1); group means of Table 2 are extracted.
Graft failures (48 eyes), rejection episodes and adverse events are reported; the article does not state how failed grafts enter the later acuity means.
Astigmatism (Table 3) and spherical equivalent (text) are reported: notes only.
Extracted under extraction protocol 1.0.0, the extraction brief and addendum 1 (development extractor D5).
